planned_success_failure_interpretation_b.distinction_from_m3gr: M3GR proved deterministic four-clip same-subset train-fit only. The future M3GU smoke would be the first reduced4 train/validation/test held-out diagnostic signal, still capped and local.
planned_success_failure_interpretation_b.success_floor_for_train_sanity: Train loss decreases from epoch 1 and train top-1 rises above random chance; stronger train fit is useful but not required for promotion because this is diagnostic.
planned_success_failure_interpretation_b.heldout_signal_interpretation: Validation/test top-1 or macro-F1 above chance with non-empty per-label recall is a candidate signal for the next diagnostic step only. It does not authorize export, model-card promotion, browser activation, final readiness, active vocabulary claim expansion, or broader training.
planned_success_failure_interpretation_b.zero_recall_interpretation: Any validation or test zero-recall label routes to reduced4 data/split/input diagnosis before another training-style retry.
planned_success_failure_interpretation_b.near_chance_or_regression_interpretation: Validation/test near chance, rotating zero-recall labels, or worse behavior than prior seven-label context routes to data/split diagnosis or strategy escalation, not another seed-only retry.
planned_success_failure_interpretation_b.missing_negative_challenge_interpretatio: Absence of negative/false-pass evidence must be recorded as a gap; threshold readiness remains unproven.
planned_success_failure_interpretation_b.command_surface_failure_interpretation: If the future reduced4 region-preserving train/eval guard cannot be satisfied, do not fit and choose the no-training data/split diagnosis route.
planned_success_failure_interpretation_b.promotion_boundary: No single local reduced4 smoke result may promote a model, edit claim surfaces, activate browser recognition, change final gates, or claim ASL correctness.
